specs.英文简介: The XR-1 is an SLR from Ricoh introduced in 1977 as the company's first SLR to use K-mount lenses, joined by the autoexposure XR-2.See a [https://www.flickr.com/photos/vox/51155948308/in/pool-camerawiki/ Ricoh advertisement] for the XR-1 and XR-2 in the December 1977 Popular Photography.
